title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Integrated Nutrition, Health and Food Security and Livelihood programme is implemented by Trócaire in Tobo, Heiban and Dellami counties, aims to contribute to Outcome 4.1: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. The activities and objective include, provision of psychosocial support in safe spaces, GBV case management to GBV survivors, establish and strengthen GBV referral mechanisms, train providers in survivor centred principles. So, women, older adolescent girls and GBV survivors use specialised interventions and psychosocial support to meet their needs and preferences. Programmes are in partnership with, Bishop Gassis Relief and Rescue Foundation (BGRRF) ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Women’s protection and access to specialised GBVsupports- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys- Support to women’s equality organisations and institutions
